newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's Apator bourse debut seen in March.
newsitem.headline: Poland's Apator bourse debut seen in March.

text.p: The first listing of the Polish gauge maker Apator SA is likely to be in March, a senior official from Creditanstalt Securities, which is offering the shares, said on Monday.
"We hope to introduce the company to the bourse within a month or two, most likely in March," Pawel Tamborski told a news conference.
Apator is offering 800,000 new shares and 600,015 existing shares, now mostly held by employees, to the public at 20 to 25 zlotys per share.
Tamborski said the final price will be set on January 24 and that issue guarantee agreements would also be signed on that day.
"Creditanstalt is currently finishing work on organising a guaranteeing consortium composed of both Polish and foreign firms and we hope to sign agreements on January 24," Tamborski said.
Investors can subscribe for the shares from January 27 to January 31. The Torun based company estimates it had a four million zlotys net profit in1996 on sales of 74 million. @
It expects to reach a net profit of 6.2 million on sales of 93.8 million in 1997 and a profit of 8.1 million on sales of 105.6 million in 1998.
